import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNext()) {
            String s = scanner.next();
            int n = s.length();
            StringBuilder outStr = new StringBuilder();
            outStr.append(s.charAt(0));
            int index = 1;
            int flagState = 0;
            while (index < n) {
                if (flagState == 0 && index < n - 2) {
                    String checkTwo = s.substring(index, index + 2);
                    if (checkTwo.equals("at")) {
                        outStr.append('@');
                        index += 2;
                        flagState++;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (index + 2 < n) {
                    String checkThree = s.substring(index, index + 3);
                    if (checkThree.equals("dot")) {
                        outStr.append('.');
                        index += 3;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                outStr.append(s.charAt(index));
                index++;
            }
            System.out.print(outStr.toString());
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
